prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: main scene illustration for Aleria's historical battle dossier, I. Seeschlacht bei Wellenruh. Bildformat 2:3 Hochformat. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Subject: an evocative northern fantasy naval battle in the Aldrimar Sea near the island of Wellenruh, medieval Nordic clinker-built longships, no cannons. Foreground: a single beautiful weathered dark wooden longship with a square muted emerald-green sail, its high curved prow cutting through blue-green waves. A second enemy longship with a burgundy-red sail in the middle distance; just three small sail silhouettes further away hint at the opposing fleets. Tiny crew silhouettes only; no identifiable named characters. A low rocky island with a few dark pines appears faintly near the horizon. Wind pulls the sails taut; seabirds, luminous pale clouds above a deep slate-teal sea. Restrained warm late morning light along the sail and foam, solemn epic mood. Strong clean ink lineart and flat cel-shaded color shapes, especially ships and water; no painterly brush texture. Calm, legible composition, a few large shapes, not overcrowded. Show complete prow and sail with comfortable margins. Upper quarter mostly quiet pale cloudy sky. No lettering, numbers, typography, captions, heraldic emblems, borders, watermarks or modern objects. Opaque background.
